note: every repair is re-implemented in c013-controlled code rather than imported from c011/c012 (§5/§6), and every one is paired with a negative control that reintroduces the old behaviour and asserts the test catches it.

repairs.original_defect: c011 stored np.random.get_state(), the legacy GLOBAL state, while the trainer sampled from an np.random.Generator. Restore restored nothing the trainer used, yet the run was described as a literal continuation.
repairs.repair: active numpy Generator persisted via rng.bit_generator.state

repairs.original_defect: cg.c009_eval.sha256_file memoises by PATH and pool workers persist. The trainer rewrote a single cur.npz, so from the second in-run evaluation onward every worker reported a stale hash, the identity check refused to score, and the P1 curriculum never left stage 0.
the condition returned None silently, which disabled the curriculum gates and early stopping for an entire 90,000-game arm without any error surfacing.
repairs.repair: a registered evaluation returning zero scored games is fatal

repairs.original_defect: c011's scale decision used the MAXIMUM bootstrap significance over any seed/metric pair, a materially weaker claim than the median.
repairs.repair: median best-per-seed is the registered statistic

repairs.original_defect: rollout-granularity accounting let each seed overshoot its registered budget because rollouts are atomic.
repairs.repair: completed games are the budget quantity

repairs.negative_control: n/a - evidenced by the panel containing the teacher
repairs.original_defect: c010 could not compare candidates to the teacher on the strategic field because the teacher was never run as a candidate on that panel.
repairs.repair: the frozen teacher is evaluated on the SAME panel as every candidate

schema.budget_quantity: completed_games (includes games with only forced decisions)
schema.hash_refresh: evaluation checkpoints are content-addressed so a per-path hash cache cannot return a stale value
schema.numpy_generator: persisted via rng.bit_generator.state; the legacy global np.random state is deliberately not used
schema.zero_score_policy: a registered evaluation returning no scored games raises ZeroScoredGamesError
